summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Healthcare 2x Daily ETF (XLVX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to 2x the daily performance of the Health Care Select Sector SPDR Fund. The fund provides leveraged exposure to U.S XLVX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
